verdict.rationale: Requesty documents a monthly spend cap on each API key or service account. The changelog adds a `monthly_budget` management parameter that replaces `monthly_limit`, so per-key budgets are a first-party capability. Service accounts separate spend from users, but nothing shows limits set per team or per user, and the docs do not say whether a cap hard-blocks requests or only alerts. Missing for 10: per-team budgets, per-user budgets, documented hard-enforcement behavior when a cap is hit, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set hard budgets and spend limits per key, team, or user

citations.quote: Each API key or service account can have its own monthly spend cap.
`monthly_limit` is deprecated and will soon be migrated to `monthly_budget`
